lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Rachel Bovard of CPI warns Democrats could follow Jack Smith’s playbook to target young Trump administration officials with costly subpoenas, Fox News reports.
Prime Minister Mark Carney now says Canada is working to become an "associate member" of the European Union, after largely avoiding that term, The Canadian Press reports.

As Canada looks to develop closer economic ties with the European Union (EU), a new report suggests there is billions of dollars’ worth of untapped demand for Canadian goods and services in Europe, The Canadian Press reports.
Patrick Stewart starred on stage and screen across his decadeslong acting career, The Associated Press reports.
Tumbler Ridge victim Maya Gebala’s father says she’s leaving hospital after 262 days, The Canadian Press reports.

Elke Sommer, the striking blonde bombshell of German descent who was a mainstay of 1960s Hollywood comedies and espionage movies including “The Prize” and “A Shot in the Dark,” has died, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
